title: Status Indicator

props.name: label
props.description: Always include readable text; a colored dot alone does not explain a status.

props.name: live
props.description: Opt in for changing status text; static indicators do not need a live region.

notes: Always provide readable label text: color and an animated dot alone do not explain status. tone is neutral/success/warning/danger/info.
pulse is opt-in for ongoing activity; paused and system reduced-motion stop the animation. Use live="polite" for changing status text; default static indicators do not announce themselves.
Use Spinner for a wait, Progress for a known amount, and StatusIndicator for persistent connectivity or synchronization state.
